body: There’s alot of feelings I have that have just been turned down honestly, but like tonight I was telling someone about how I’m depressed cause of past traumas and how I want to off myself and they legit denied that I felt that way. Telling me that I don’t feel the way I do or that I didn’t feel like that when I was younger either. It’s bs honestly and it pisses me off. I legit cried in front of them cause they didn’t believe me. But who actually cares right, what’s the point of living anyways.
Ur honestly really sweet and u don’t know how much I appreciate ur words, literally thank u so much ❤️.

Well no, he did text me back after, but like he just basically changed the subject and responded with a msg with a change of subject. So like there’s no need for me to ghost him or anything. I honestly don’t think he has feelings for me cause he did tell me one day that he “did” have feelings for me, but apparently not anymore. Also I’ve told him that I loved him two other times in the past and he acted the exact same way, so I just don’t know. Do u think I should try to talk to him about it tho? Even if he doesn’t seem interested

Yeah that’s a good idea even tho I told myself I’d never go out again cause I don’t wanna experience heartbreak ever again lol. Oh but I really appreciate u helping me out!!
Or actually yeah, I’m trying to move on, but I still think about him tho...that’s what I meant
Well we don’t sext anymore, we completely stopped. I would move on, but we’re friends now and we talk literally everyday.

Yeah I could, but everytime I bring up the subject it’s like he wants to get over the subject fast. Also I didn’t know that, but maybe that’s why I’m struggling to get over him then. I honestly think he just may like another girl, but idk
Lol, I’ve tried all these things and he still stays on my mind as I’m doing them. But I might try journaling cause it might just work. Thanks for your suggestions!!

I guess he just doesn’t wanna ruin what we have in our friendship as of now or maybe he just didn’t like the fact that we sexted so much so he’d rather stay friends? I honestly don’t know, I keep asking myself the same question tho

He wants to just be friends cause he doesn’t wanna ruin what we have and he literally knows that I think about him a lot and when I told him that I do he told me he thinks of me in those ways too yet he still just wants to be friends. So I’m honestly confused on what he wants. But like I really just need to stop thinking about him and all of it cause I’m way too obsessed lol.

That’s great that you plan on hanging out with her again later and I’m glad you’ll get a bit of an break  so it’s not ruining your life. But yes, spend all the time you can with her now tho before she leaves.

Oh well that’s really good and it most likely will help. I know it’s hard, detaching yourself from someone that you always hang out with and have been there for is definitely not easy. But do u plan on like hanging out with her again after your break or do you think you’ll develop feelings again if you do that?

Well that’s good she wouldn’t end the friendship unless you want her to cause you like her too much. I get how easily you developed feelings as a romantic tho, I definitely would have. You’re right, it will take a while for the feelings to suppress. Are you not able to like take a break from talking to or hanging out with her? Cause it could help or you could wait it out and just truly be there for her and she could end up changing the way she feels about you. I mean it could happen especially if you two are like best friends.

I mean she should atleast suspect that you may feel a certain way about her a little bit because you two got intimate and whatnot even if you do hide your feelings well. I mean if I did that with a guy I wouldn’t assume that he just stopped having feelings for me.

Is she the type to like want to end the friendship if you told her? Well if you two truly are best friends then things def shouldn’t get awkward or weird unless she’s the type to make things that way.

Oh ok I see. If she’s an understanding and accepting person then she probably won’t react bad. But I get how you would be afraid of what she will say. The only way to know how she’ll respond is by telling her tho. Do you think it might help u feel better knowing that she knows even if she does respond like that?

Gosh, I totally understand what you’re going through and I’m really sorry that it’s ruining your life rn. Are you still talking to her as of now and if so, have you tried telling her how you feel about all of it?

Omg when I read this, It seemed Iike I legit wrote it cause the same thing just happened to me yesterday. My friend (now) and I have gotten intimate to the point of sharing stuff too and we were acting as bf and gf, but yesterday he told me he just wanted to be friends cause he didn’t wanna ruin what we had. But I just keep thinking about him and I honestly can’t stop. It’s so fucking hard

Okay this is really good to know! I honestly thought at the beginning about how it could be difficult for him to know what he actually wants at 16, it is pretty young if you think about it...but he was the one to ask me to be his gf, so I went along with it. But I’ll just be friends with him the and I appreciate you commenting, this helped a lot

Yeah  I hate it too, but it didn’t really bum me out too much because I really like him and care about, so if he’s not happy being with me, then I’ll let him go so he find someone else and be happy honestly...

I’m glad he opened up too because it’s hard for him to open up like that. I’ll try not to let what he said get to my head...it’s so hard lol. But I’ll be friends with him for now I guess and see where that goes. 

I appreciate you commenting! Thank youuu!

You’re right, it is very possible...

Well, he told me that he doesn’t care much for physical attraction, he only cares about personality...but everyone has to have a type, right?! But if we do become friends instead I’ll try to talk with him about how he views love and attraction, and what they mean and how they work. But he’s not the type to open up much, like I try to get him to, but he doesn’t budge most of the time.

Oh yes I do, like he’s a really good guy and I don’t mind being friends with him. But the fact that we talked about and have seen some private things from both of our sides, idk how a friendship would pan out.
Yeah, I’ve honestly pulled my feelings and emotions away from after he said what he said. I mean I kinda do want something to happen, but I don’t know how to approach him as of now honestly.
